name: Honey Chicken
author: Braiden Crawley
steps: In a bowl, mix honey, olive oil, vinegar/lime juice, and all seasonings together into a thick paste.
Coat chicken well in the mixture.
Let marinate at least 30 minutes, or up to overnight in the fridge.
[option] Grill: Cook over medium-high heat, about 5-7 minutes per side until done.
[option] Stovetop: Pan-sear in a skillet over medium heat for 6-8 minutes per side.
[option] Oven: Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 20-25 minutes, broil the last 2 mins for char.
[option] Air fryer: 375°F for 15-18 minutes, flipping halfway.
